label: Set up
hint: Clear the table and lay out the 36 cards, shuffled.
confirm: This clears the table and sets it up again. Continue?

label: Deal 12 each
hint: Twelve cards, face up, into each player's hand.
announce: {name} dealt twelve cards to each player.

label: Call time
hint: End trading and keep a record of every hand.
confirm: Call time? Trading ends and open offers are withdrawn. Pairs who have not traded yet are noted in the record.

label: Reset
hint: Remove every card and all ink.
confirm: This removes every card and all ink from the table. Continue?

label: Collect all cards
hint: Every card back into the deck, face down, shuffled.
announce: {name} collected every card into the deck.
